Do not sort/deduplicate, spread optional fields or centralize semantic validation. Path types are structurally readonly string|number arrays; helper must avoid schema/wire cycle.

findings.verdict: confirmed cycle-safe calendar leaves
actual_anchors: kinds.ts:82-106 and temporal.ts:58-82 match leap arithmetic and daysInMonth switch/default0 exactly.
temporal.ts:32 runtime-imports kinds; kinds.ts:154-159 documents existing temporal back-edge avoidance.
kinds admission/makeDate:108-136; temporal date/datetime/month clamp calls:203,242,321 use same month leaf.

Keep invalid month default0, signed remainder/NaN behavior, proleptic rules; runtime Date/Intl replacement adds unrelated host/timezone policy. DATETIME constants are explicitly outside bounded move.
